    command = [go, 'vet', './internal/flowgraph'] if vet else [go, 'test', '-json', '-count=1']
    if not vet:
        if race:
            command.append('-race')
        if pattern:

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

repo, out, go, phase = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4]
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
records = []
source = repo / 'services/bff'
compiler = source / 'internal/flowgraph/compiler.go'
original = compiler.read_text()
env = dict(os.environ, GOTOOLCHAIN='local', GOFLAGS='-buildvcs=false -mod=readonly')

def save():
    summary = {'phase': phase, 'go': go,
               'goVersion': subprocess.check_output([go, 'version'], text=True).strip(),
               'sourceSHA': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=repo, text=True).strip(),
               'compilerSHA256': hashlib.sha256(compiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               'testSHA256': hashlib.sha256((source / 'internal/flowgraph/compiler_test.go').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               'records': records}
    (out / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
    return summary

def run(name, root, pattern=None, race=False, vet=False):
    command = [go, 'vet', './internal/flowgraph'] if vet else [go, 'test', '-json', '-count=1']
    if not vet:
        if race:
            command.append('-race')
        if pattern:
            command.extend(['-run', pattern])
        command.append('./internal/flowgraph')
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    (out / (name + '.stdout')).write_text(result.stdout)
    (out / (name + '.stderr')).write_text(result.stderr)
    records.append({'name': name, 'command': command, 'cwd': str(root), 'exit': result.returncode,
                    'stdout': name + '.stdout', 'stderr': name + '.stderr'})
    save()
    return result.returncode

if run('baseline-bpmn', source, '^TestRootBPMN') != 0:
    raise RuntimeError('Baseline failed; no valid mutant measurement')
if run('baseline-package-race', source, race=True) != 0:
    raise RuntimeError('Package baseline failed')

def node(n):
    return 'n_' + ('%08x000040008000%012x' % (n, n))

variants = {
    'wrong-false-target': ('id="e_3" sourceRef="' + node(3) + '" targetRef="' + node(5) + '"',
                           'id="e_3" sourceRef="' + node(3) + '" targetRef="' + node(4) + '"'),
    'wrong-start-source': ('id="e_0" sourceRef="' + node(1) + '" targetRef="' + node(2) + '"',
                           'id="e_0" sourceRef="' + node(5) + '" targetRef="' + node(2) + '"'),
}
needle = '\treturn output.Bytes(), nil\n'
assert original.count(needle) == 1
for name, (before, after) in variants.items():
    target = out / 'variants' / name / 'services/bff'
    shutil.copytree(source, target, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('.work', 'node_modules', '__pycache__'))
    replacement = '\treturn bytes.Replace(output.Bytes(), []byte(`' + before + '`), []byte(`' + after + '`), 1), nil\n'
    (target / 'internal/flowgraph/compiler.go').write_text(original.replace(needle, replacement))
    probe = ('package flowgraph\nimport("bytes";"testing")\n'
             'func TestV056MutationProbe(t *testing.T) {\n'
             'raw, err := CompileBPMN(graph(), fields(), rid(99)); if err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}\n'
             'if !bytes.Contains(raw, []byte(`' + after + '`)) || bytes.Contains(raw, []byte(`' + before + '`)) '
             '{t.Fatal("mutation did not affect the fixed fixture output")}\n}\n')
    (target / 'internal/flowgraph/v056_mutation_probe_test.go').write_text(probe)
    if run(name + '-probe', target, '^TestV056MutationProbe$') != 0:

    run(name + '-bpmn', target, '^TestRootBPMN')
